mquestions.why: 3. B) contaminated。may be 后面接形容词或过去分词作表语；老工业用地的土壤「可能被污染」，与 may be unsafe 的逻辑一致。
mquestions.unit: 选词填空 · 城市农场

mquestions.why: 4. C) certain。be certain to do 是固定搭配「必定会」。此处说「这一趋势必定会继续扩大」，与后文 but they warn 形成让步。
mquestions.unit: 选词填空 · 城市农场

mquestions.why: 5. N) replace。expect it to ___ conventional agriculture，需要一个及物动词原形；replace 与后文 not whether cities can grow food 呼应。注意 decline 作动词是「拒绝」，语义不通。
mquestions.unit: 选词填空 · 城市农场

mquestions.why: 6. F) engage。engage in 是固定搭配「参与」。定语从句 Children who ___ in planting 缺谓语，且必须是原形复数一致的形式。
mquestions.unit: 选词填空 · 城市农场

mquestions.why: 7. K) a shift in eating habits。report a ___ in 需要名词；shift 指「转变」，与后文孩子更愿意吃蔬菜的结果对应。
mquestions.unit: 选词填空 · 城市农场

mquestions.why: 8. H) expand。to ___ these projects 需要动词原形，expand 表示「扩大规模」，与 without pushing up house prices 构成现实的张力。
mquestions.unit: 选词填空 · 城市农场

mquestions.why: 9. I) occurred。has already ___ 是现在完成时，必须填过去分词；occur 的过去分词 occurred（双写 r）。语义为「这种风险在若干街区已经出现」。
mquestions.unit: 选词填空 · 城市农场

mquestions.why: 10. J) question。The real ___ is not whether… but whether… 是典型的「真正的+名词」句式，question 表示「问题所在」。harvest 虽同为名词，但「真正的收获不是能否种菜」讲不通。
mquestions.unit: 选词填空 · 城市农场

mquestions.st: Remote teams produced fewer new ideas because people stopped meeting colleagues outside their own group.
mquestions.loc: B 段：weak ties 减少四分之一，而 weak ties 是信息跨部门流动的通道；「outside their own group」即 weak ties 的改写。
mquestions.why: B 段：weak ties 减少四分之一，而 weak ties 是信息跨部门流动的通道；「outside their own group」即 weak ties 的改写。
mquestions.unit: 长篇阅读 · 远程办公的代价

mquestions.st: Senior managers tend to value the office more than younger staff do.
mquestions.loc: C 段：senior staff rate remote work far lower than their junior colleagues，题干把 lower rating 改写成 value more。
mquestions.why: C 段：senior staff rate remote work far lower than their junior colleagues，题干把 lower rating 改写成 value more。
mquestions.unit: 长篇阅读 · 远程办公的代价

mquestions.st: New employees find it harder to learn the unwritten rules of a workplace when they start online.
mquestions.loc: D 段：junior staff who joined remotely…struggle to negotiate internally；「unwritten rules」对应 learn by overhearing how a client is handled。
mquestions.why: D 段：junior staff who joined remotely…struggle to negotiate internally；「unwritten rules」对应 learn by overhearing how a client is handled。
mquestions.unit: 长篇阅读 · 远程办公的代价

mquestions.st: Companies are settling on a predictable weekly pattern rather than a fixed number of days.
mquestions.loc: E 段：fixed pattern…What matters is that the days are predictable。注意题干没有说「几天」，而是强调「可预期」。
mquestions.why: E 段：fixed pattern…What matters is that the days are predictable。注意题干没有说「几天」，而是强调「可预期」。
mquestions.unit: 长篇阅读 · 远程办公的代价

mquestions.st: The debate has shifted from location to which work needs to be done together.
mquestions.loc: F 段：the question is not where people work but which tasks genuinely need to be done together。
mquestions.why: F 段：the question is not where people work but which tasks genuinely need to be done together。
mquestions.unit: 长篇阅读 · 远程办公的代价

mquestions.st: What is the main reason so much edible food is thrown away?
o: Supermarkets sell food that is already old.
Shoppers misunderstand what the dates mean.
Food prices are too low to encourage care.
Fridges are often set at the wrong temperature.
mquestions.loc: The confusion is built into the language… Most shoppers do not know the difference.
mquestions.why: 第二段开头 The confusion is built into the language，全文的核心原因是消费者分不清 use by 与 best before 的含义。
on: 原文没有说超市卖即将过期的食品，只说日期被印得很晚。
正确项。
价格与冰箱温度都没有出现。
同上，无中生有。
mquestions.tip: 问 reason / why 时，锁定解释性段落，不要停在现象段。
mquestions.pit: 把第一段的现象（三分之一被扔）当成原因。
mquestions.unit: 仔细阅读 · 保质期标签与食物浪费

mquestions.st: What does the author say about "best before" dates?
o: They indicate that the food is no longer safe.
They are required by law for all packaged food.
They concern taste rather than safety.
They are used mainly by shop staff.
mquestions.loc: «Best before» is a quality date: the food is still safe afterwards, it simply may not taste as good.
mquestions.why: 原文 «Best before» is a quality date: the food is still safe afterwards, it simply may not taste as good，即管品质不管安全。
on: 「过期就不安全」是 use by 的含义，属于两者互换。
原文没有提法律强制。
正确项。
主要用于店员的是 display until，不是 best before。
mquestions.tip: 遇到两个易混概念，先在纸上各写一行定义，再对选项。
mquestions.pit: use by 与 best before 的定义被故意调换，这是本篇最核心的陷阱。
mquestions.unit: 仔细阅读 · 保质期标签与食物浪费

mquestions.st: Why do manufacturers add salt or remove water?
o: To make the food taste better
To allow a later date to be printed
To reduce the cost of production
To meet new government standards
mquestions.loc: …adding salt or removing water — to make those dates achievable.
mquestions.why: 原文 some adjust the recipe — adding salt or removing water — to make those dates achievable，目的是让印上去的日期能兑现，从而「保质期更长更好卖」。
on: 口味改变只是副作用，原文没说是为了更好吃。
正确项。
成本未被提及，加水/加盐与成本无关。
没有政府标准。
mquestions.tip: 目的题看 to / so as to / in order to 后面的不定式。
mquestions.pit: 把「加盐」理解为改善风味，忽略了破折号后的 to make those dates achievable。
mquestions.unit: 仔细阅读 · 保质期标签与食物浪费

mquestions.st: What can be inferred from the last paragraph?
o: Date labels should be abolished immediately.
Consumers should rely on their own senses.
Food past its date is always safe to eat.
Supermarkets should stop printing any dates.
mquestions.loc: The useful question is not «is it out of date?» but «does it look, smell and taste right?»
mquestions.why: 作者说日期是「为平均厨房写的规则，不是为你家的」；有用的问题不是「过期了吗」而是「看起来、闻起来、尝起来对不对」——即回到自己的感官判断。
on: 作者说的是「不能只靠标签」，没有主张立刻废除。
正确项，与 look, smell and taste 对应。
原文明确 use by 之后可能致病，不能说 always safe。
过于绝对，且与全文语气不符。
mquestions.tip: 推断题的正确项通常是「弱化表述」：should consider、may、tend to。
mquestions.pit: 推断题里出现 always / never / immediately 这类词，基本可以直接排除。
mquestions.unit: 仔细阅读 · 保质期标签与食物浪费

mquestions.st: What does the figure of nine percent refer to?
o: The share of plastic waste recycled since the 1950s
The share of plastic burned in Europe
The share of packaging made of paper
The share of oil used to make plastic
mquestions.loc: The figure that campaigners repeat most often is nine percent: the share of all plastic waste that has been recycled since the material became common in the 1950s.
mquestions.why: 第一段直接定义：the share of all plastic waste that has been recycled since the material became common in the 1950s。
on: 正确项，与原文定义一致。
焚烧比例在第三、四段出现，但不是 9% 所指。
纸包装是第三段末尾提到的替代材料。
原文没有给「制塑用油占比」。
mquestions.tip: 数据题先把冒号后面的解释读完，答案通常就在冒号后。
mquestions.pit: 后文出现 fuel for burning、paper packaging，容易把 9% 和它们关联。
mquestions.unit: 仔细阅读 · 塑料回收的真相

mquestions.st: Why is sorting plastic difficult according to the passage?
o: Because households refuse to wash their bins
Because plastics vary and sensors miss some types
Because there are too few recycling plants
Because paper is mixed with plastic
mquestions.loc: Plastics are not one material but thousands… machines that sort by colour or shape are easily confused by black plastic, which sensors cannot detect.
mquestions.why: 第二段给出两个原因：塑料种类多、熔点不同，且 machines that sort by colour or shape are easily confused by black plastic, which sensors cannot detect。
on: 原文没有提到居民不清洗回收桶。
正确项：种类繁多 + 传感器识别不了黑色塑料。
原文提到工厂关闭，但那是经济原因导致的，不是分拣难的原因。
纸是替代包装材料，与分拣难无直接因果。
mquestions.tip: 问 why 时只读带 because / the reason / part of the explanation 的句子。
mquestions.pit: several sorting plants closed 出现在第三段，属于「结果」而非「原因」。
mquestions.unit: 仔细阅读 · 塑料回收的真相

mquestions.st: What is the critics' view of chemical recycling?
o: It produces high-quality food packaging.
It saves more energy than it consumes.
It often produces fuel rather than new plastic.
It has replaced mechanical recycling.
mquestions.loc: Critics reply that most of these plants run at low temperatures and produce fuel for burning, not new plastic, and that the process uses more energy than it saves.
mquestions.why: Critics reply that most of these plants… produce fuel for burning, not new plastic, and that the process uses more energy than it saves。
on: 只有 3/60 的工厂能产出食品级材料，与「高质量」相反。
原文说 uses more energy than it saves，方向相反。
正确项：多数产出的是燃料，不是新塑料。
化学回收是补充路线，原文没有说取代机械回收。
mquestions.tip: 看到 Supporters… Critics… 先标说话人，问谁的观点就只读谁那句。
mquestions.pit: Supporters describe it as closing the loop 是支持者的话，被放在前面，容易被当成作者态度。
mquestions.unit: 仔细阅读 · 塑料回收的真相

mquestions.st: What can be inferred from the last paragraph?
o: Households should sort waste more carefully.
System design matters more than individual effort.
Deposit schemes are too expensive for most countries.
Recycling should be abandoned altogether.
mquestions.loc: Countries with deposit schemes and repair shops recycle far more… not because their citizens are more careful, but because the system makes the easy choice the right one.
mquestions.why: 末段说：not because their citizens are more careful, but because the system makes the easy choice the right one，并强调 recycling works best when there is less to recycle。
on: 原文明确否定了「居民更细心」这个解释。
正确项：制度设计比个人努力更关键。
原文把押金制当正面例子，没有说太贵。
作者说 recycling works best when there is less to recycle，不是放弃回收。
mquestions.tip: 推理题优先找 not…but…、rather than、the more honest conclusion 这类评价句。
mquestions.pit: not because A, but because B 结构里，A 经常被误读成作者观点。
mquestions.unit: 仔细阅读 · 塑料回收的真相

mquestions.st: 剪纸是中国最受欢迎的民间艺术之一，已有一千五百多年的历史。剪纸的材料很简单：一把剪刀、几张彩纸。人们用剪刀把纸剪成各种图案，如花鸟、人物和汉字。在中国的传统习俗中，红色的剪纸常被贴在窗户和门上，尤其是在春节时，以增添喜庆的气氛。剪纸作品还常常被用来装饰礼品，表达人们对美好生活的向往。2009 年，中国剪纸被列入联合国教科文组织的人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
mquestions.ref: Paper cutting, one of the most popular folk arts in China, has a history of more than 1,500 years. The materials for paper cutting are very simple: a pair of scissors and several pieces of colored paper. With scissors, people cut the paper into various patterns, such as flowers and birds, figures and Chinese characters. According to Chinese tradition, red paper-cut works are often pasted on windows and doors, especially during the Spring Festival, to add to the festive atmosphere. Paper-cut works are also frequently used to decorate gifts, expressing people's longing for a better life. In 2009, Chinese paper cutting was inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity of UNESCO.
bd: 最受欢迎的民间艺术之一 → one of the most popular folk arts（one of + 复数 folk arts；art 表「艺术门类」可数）
已有一千五百多年的历史 → has a history of more than 1,500 years（也可用 dating back over 1,500 years 分词结构）
把纸剪成各种图案 → cut the paper into various patterns（cut… into… 固定搭配；「各种」various / all kinds of）
常被贴在窗户和门上 → are often pasted on windows and doors（中文主动「贴」，英文必须被动 be pasted；paste 比 stick 更准确）
以增添喜庆的气氛 → to add to the festive atmosphere（add to 是「增添」，不是 add… to… 的「把……加到」；「喜庆的」festive，不是 happy）
表达人们对美好生活的向往 → expressing people's longing for a better life（分词作状语；longing for 是固定搭配）
被列入……名录 → was inscribed on the Representative List…（官方表述 inscribe on the list；写不全会就降级 be listed as intangible cultural heritage，不要空着）
mquestions.unit: 翻译 · 剪纸

mquestions.st: Directions: The Students' Union of your university is going to organize a volunteer teaching program in a rural primary school during the summer vacation. Write a notice to recruit student volunteers, introducing the program and the requirements. Do not use your real name; use «Li Ming» or «The Students' Union». You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
mquestions.sample:
NOTICE

A volunteer teaching program will be launched by the Students' Union this summer vacation, and volunteers are now being recruited.
The program aims to bring English and computer classes to pupils in Hope Primary School in a nearby county. Ten volunteers are needed. Applicants are expected to be patient with children, to speak fluent English, and to stay for the whole program from July 10th to July 30th. Teaching experience is preferred but not required; a training session will be provided before departure.
This is a precious opportunity to put what you have learned into practice and to bring knowledge to children in the countryside. Those who are interested please fill in the application form at the office of the Students' Union (Room 302, Student Center) before June 25th.

The Students' Union
outline: 标题 Notice；第一段：一句话说明活动与目的
第二段：招募要求（人数、条件）与志愿服务内容
第三段：时间地点、报名方式与截止日期；落款 The Students' Union
mquestions.unit: 写作 · 通知（志愿者招募）
